ALLOWED.label: Allowed
ALLOWED.hint: Active in the catalog. Each mode still applies its own rules: this status never opens a sensitive mode by itself.

RESTRICTED.label: Restricted
RESTRICTED.hint: Neutral modes only. This is where every new character starts.

EXCLUDED.label: Excluded
EXCLUDED.hint: Removed from every mode, neutral ones included.

eligibility.compositeNote: Chaos Mix has no content of its own. Every round it draws is checked on the server against the mode it was drawn for and the image used.
eligibility.legendEligibility: Eligibility: what the character may be used for, from its status, safety classification and universe settings.
eligibility.legendImages: Images: how many of its images were approved one by one. A playable challenge needs both.

reasons.CHARACTER_EXCLUDED: The character is excluded from the game.
reasons.MODE_DISABLED_FOR_UNIVERSE: This mode is not enabled for the universe.
reasons.MODE_BLOCKED_FOR_CHARACTER: This mode is blocked for this character.
reasons.CORE_EXCLUSION: Fundamental exclusion: cannot be lifted from this interface.
reasons.STATUS_RESTRICTED: The status is Restricted (neutral modes only).
reasons.NOT_ADULT_VERIFIED: The character is not classified as a verified adult.
reasons.ASSET_NOT_APPROVED: The image has not been approved for this mode.
reasons.UNIVERSE_SENSITIVE_LOCKED: Sensitive modes are locked for this universe (young-audience franchise).
reasons.MODE_IS_COMPOSITE: Mix of other modes: each round is checked under its own mode.
reasons.UNIVERSE_UNREVIEWED: This universe has not been reviewed yet: sensitive modes stay locked until it is classified.

characters.title: Characters
characters.addHint: A new character always starts as Restricted and Not reviewed.
characters.searchPlaceholder: Name or alias, in any language
characters.bulkHint: Bulk changes only touch the status, never the safety classification.

character.aliasesHint: Separate aliases with commas. They will count as correct answers in that language.
character.statusNote: The status and the safety classification are two separate settings.
character.classificationIntro: Only a verified adult, with a non-childlike appearance and presentation, can appear in sensitive modes. Small stature alone proves nothing either way: judge each character individually, and when in doubt choose Ambiguous age.
character.coreExcluded: This character is permanently excluded from sensitive modes. It can never be classified as a verified adult.
character.noteHint: Optional. Explain the choice for the next reviewer.
character.noteHintAdult: Required: at least {{count}} characters. State the source for the age and why the appearance is not childlike.
character.confirmAdult: I have checked this character individually: adult according to the official material, non-childlike appearance and presentation, no ambiguity.
character.blockedIntro: Tick a mode to keep this character out of it, whatever its status.
character.eligibilityIntro: Computed by the server from every rule. This is what the game will apply.
character.variantsIntro: Variants inherit every restriction of the character. A skin can never unlock a mode.

universes.title: Universes
universes.addHint: A new universe starts with neutral modes only and must be reviewed before any sensitive mode can be enabled.
universes.youthNotice: Franchise associated with a young audience. Sensitive modes stay locked here unless you unlock them explicitly. Even then, only individually verified adults with individually approved images can ever appear in them.
universes.unlockIntro: Unlocking is a deliberate exception, never a default. It is recorded with your justification. Characters and images keep every one of their own checks.
universes.unlockConfirm: I understand this is an exception: only verified adults with individually approved images can be eligible, and minors, childlike or ambiguous characters never are.
universes.lockHint: Locking switches every sensitive mode off for this universe immediately.

audienceHint.GENERAL: Reviewed: not aimed at a young audience. Sensitive modes can be enabled here, for individually verified adults and approved images only.
audienceHint.YOUTH: Aimed at a young audience. Sensitive modes stay locked unless you unlock them explicitly below.
audienceHint.UNREVIEWED: Nobody has reviewed this universe yet. Sensitive modes stay locked until it is classified.

universes.audienceNoteHint: At least {{count}} characters. Say why this universe is not aimed at a young audience.
universes.audienceConfirm: I have reviewed this universe: it is not aimed at a young audience. This changes nothing for minors, childlike or ambiguous characters, who stay excluded from sensitive modes.
universes.audienceFixed: The code fixes this universe as young-audience. It can be made stricter, never more permissive.
universes.audienceStricter: A stricter classification applies at once and switches every sensitive mode off for this universe.
universes.unreviewedNotice: This universe has not been reviewed. Sensitive modes stay locked until you classify it below.

history.title: History
history.intro: Every change is recorded. A change can be restored as long as nothing newer has replaced it.

images.title: Images
images.intro: The eligibility of a character and the approval of each of its images are two separate things: a challenge needs both.
